title: The keyboard cannot get around permission or status limits
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 1 or 2 browsers · about 25 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • [User-A]: your dispatcher login (Work Orders create and edit) — Owner/Admin: on a QA branch the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit. [User-A] also does the setup.
  • [User-B]: a view-only user (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer") whose role (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") has under Work orders only View ticked, at the test location; signed in later in a second browser or a private window.
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location. Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  • Technicians (examples, the expected results call them by first name or full name): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo". A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > the staff member's edit icon > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, Time Clock is on, the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customers (used by this case only, each with one contact and one asset): "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits Bravo Co". The steps and expected results call them by the end of the name ("Alpha Co", "Bravo Co").
  • Work orders with lead Ana: Alpha Co Approved, Bravo Co Invoiced.
  • None of these technicians has a shift on the Schedule for these work orders (check the Schedule page). If a window titled "Clear … scheduled shifts?" still appears during a move, click "Keep shifts".
  • The keyboard and focus design is not finished yet (the design shows no keyboard behaviour). Where a step names a key, try Tab, Shift+Tab, the arrow keys, Enter, Space and Escape, and write down which key does what.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo" exist and count as technicians at this location (edit icon > Edit Staff Member). To add one: New Staff Member with those settings (at least one Department is required) (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha") > Save & Close.
  2. Create a view-only user (skip if one exists): Settings > Roles & Permissions > Create Custom Role > Skip > Role Name (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST WO View Only") > under Work orders tick only View > Create. Then Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member (e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Viewer", an email inbox you can open) with that role at the test location, and finish the invite so the user can sign in. Record this user as [User-B].
  3. Create this case's customers: "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits Alpha Co", "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits Bravo Co". For each: top menu Customers > New Customer, Name > Save; on the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact); then the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create each work order listed in the Preconditions: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick the Customer and its Asset > Save. Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate (it opens with the New Line form: pick a ready-made line and Save & Close); for Approved turn on Line Approved on its line; for In Progress click Start on the line's Labor row (stop the clock afterwards with Stop > Clock Out); for Review click the line's Complete button, type a Tech Story (fill any missing detail it asks for, e.g. Mileage) and click Complete Line (the List shows "Ready For Review"); for Complete then click Mark Reviewed, enter the VIN if asked and click Confirm Review; for Declined save the line with Line Approved off and click Decline on it (it must be the work order's only line); for Invoiced complete and review it first, then Finance tab > Create Invoice; for Paid, after invoicing, Finance tab > New Payment for the full amount > Make Payment. Set the lead technician before invoicing. Once the work order is Approved, pick the technician in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page (leave it as Unassigned for an unassigned one). (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.) Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801); the steps call each work order by the end of its customer name (e.g. "Alpha Co").
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits" in Search — (as [User-A]) exactly 2 work orders show, both led by Ana: Alpha Co Approved, Bravo Co Invoiced. If anything differs, correct that work order (status or Lead Technician) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the view-only user [User-B], open Work Orders > All, search "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Keyboard Limits" and click Board View.
  2. Using only the keyboard, move focus onto the Alpha Co card and try every key that could open a menu or move it (Enter, Space, the arrow keys, Shift plus the arrow keys).
  3. Sign in as the dispatcher [User-A] in the same way and click Board View.
  4. Using only the keyboard, focus the Bravo Co card (Invoiced), reach its more-actions button and press Enter.
  5. Move focus to "Reassign lead technician" in the menu and press Enter.
  6. Try any keyboard move of Bravo Co to Ben's column, then refresh and open Bravo Co to read Lead Technician.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: the view-only user cannot open Reassign lead technician or move the card with any key. Alpha Co keeps its place and its lead.
  • Steps 4 and 5: the menu opens, but "Reassign lead technician" is disabled for the Invoiced work order and Enter does nothing. Its tooltip, if you can reach it, reads "The lead technician can't be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid."
  • Step 6: Bravo Co cannot be moved to another technician by keyboard and still has Lead Technician Ana Alpha.
  • The exact keys are still being designed; this case fails only if a key lets the user do something the mouse may not.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S11-N1, S4-N6, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, SQ-15 (Open) and UX-19 (Open). Inline PRD comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 28 Sep 2026, lists what is still open with design. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-N1: “Keyboard access must not bypass action permissions or work order status restrictions.”
  • S4-N6: “The disabled Reassign lead technician action on an Invoiced or Paid work order shows this tooltip: “The lead technician can’t be changed once a work order is Invoiced or Paid.””
  • Tech plan Phase 11 tests: “a keyboard-initiated reassign is refused for a locked status and without permission (S11-N1).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
